posts.author: TRIDIUM
posts.body:
This pride month, take a break from the corporate pandering and create a beach themed game. Whether it be gay, straight, trans, or something else, celebrate your identity in a short game made with RPG Maker. All identities are welcome!
Here's a link to a collection of beach themed resources!
Beach/Pride resources
*Rules*
-Game must be under 30 minutes
-No AI
-Custom art/resources are allowed
-Must fit the theme
-You may only use RPG Maker 2k, 2k3, xp, vx, vxace, mv, mz, or unite
-Starts June 1st, ends June 31st
-Teams are okay
-No extreme gore/nsfw
-Must be playable on a windows 10 PC
*Categories*
We'll share what are favorite game was for each of these categories! There are no prizes, this is all just for fun and to celebrate summer/pride month.
-Most fun to play
-Best story/characters/writing
-Best looking
-Personal favorite
Hosted my
@TRIDIUM
and
@Ms Littlefish
Make sure to submit your entry on itchio! (Free free to share here though!)
Beach Pride RPG Maker Jam
A game jam from 2026-06-01 to 2026-07-14 hosted by TRIDIUM & Littlefish Atelier. This pride month, take a break from the corporate pandering and create a beach themed game. Whether it be gay, straight, trans, or something else, cel...

posts.author: Ms Littlefish
posts.body:
Yeah, I’d say it’s more about scope creep. Short ‘n sweet. It’s not like we’ll have a timer and shut the game off as soon as the clock strikes. I suppose y’all could technically have a minute long game, but I kinda don’t think it would do super duper either.
Well. Not unless you have a genius idea I cannot comprehend.
